annotations.title: Ferry, speedboat, van and taxi transfers in Thailand

description: Transfers across the whole of Thailand: ferries, speedboats and catamarans between the islands (Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Koh Phi Phi, Koh Lanta, Koh Yao, Koh Lipe, Samui, Phangan, Tao, Koh Chang, Koh Kood…), shared vans and private taxis between towns and airports. Departure times, operator, piers or pickup point, price per person or per vehicle, and a photo page of the boat. Routes Phi Phi Paradise organizes (its boats between Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Koh Phi Phi, Railay, Koh Lipe and Koh Yao, and partner companies with a trip_id) are booked with book_transfer; every other route is listed at its 12Go price with a 12Go booking link (12Go, our partner, takes the booking and the payment).

date.description: Travel date YYYY-MM-DD (checks the 48h booking notice).

from.description: Departure place, e.g. Phuket, Krabi, Ao Nang, Phi Phi, Koh Lanta.

lang.description: Traveller language code for the booking links (en, fr, de…).
